hostname ix-g02
!
logging buffered 65536
logging subsystem all warn
logging timestamp datetime
service password-encryption
!
username admin password plain dummy-admin-secret-1 administrator
!
class-map match-any cm-g-voice
  match cos 5
  match qos-group 10
!
policy-map pm-g-in
  class cm-g-voice
    set qos-group 10
  class class-local
  class class-default
policy-map pm-g-out
  class cm-g-voice
    priority percent 20
  class class-local
  class class-default
!
ip route default GigaEthernet0.1
!
ssh-server ip enable
terminal timeout 10
!
ppp profile Dialer1
  authentication myname example-user@example.net
  authentication password example-user@example.net dummy-ppp-password
  authentication request chap
  authentication accept chap
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  description sample wan
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet0.1
  description sample pppoe
  ip address ipcp
  ip mtu 1454
  ip tcp adjust-mss 1414
  ppp binding Dialer1
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0
  description sample lan
  ip address 198.51.100.1/24
  service-policy input pm-g-in
  service-policy enable
  service-policy output pm-g-out
  no shutdown
!
